# Release v1 — generated by scripts/27_package_release.py (regenerate rather than hand-edit)

Generated 2026-10-18 11:45. Target: CELLxGENE schema 7.1.0 (not yet validated with `cellxgene-schema`).

## dmg_atlas_v1.h5ad

- 311,618 cells / nuclei x 18,865 genes (GENCODE v48 versionless Ensembl IDs; of 33 atlas IDs absent from v48, 16 remapped by unique gene name and 17 dropped: `results/tables/release_genes_dropped.csv`).
- `X` = raw UMI counts, float32 CSR (no normalised matrix, no `raw`, no layers). `var['gene_symbol']` = atlas symbol, `var['feature_is_filtered']` = False.
- obsm: X_scanvi, X_scvi, X_scvi_malignant, X_umap (X_scvi_malignant is NaN outside the malignant subset). uns: title, organism_ontology_term_id, batch_condition ['sample_id'], default_embedding X_umap, release, plus the atlas_core uns.
- md5 `fa34ed4c9368960930eca7b653a2fbb0`; source atlas_core.h5ad md5 `ded17c5f9f9d5cfa2dab16c02bb64b92`.

## CELLxGENE field mapping

Fixed: tissue_type 'tissue'; self_reported_ethnicity_ontology_term_id 'unknown'; is_primary_data False (meta-analysis of published deposits); donor_id = patient_id; suspension_type cell (scRNA) / nucleus (snRNA, multiome). Atlas columns `assay` and `sex` are renamed `assay_atlas` / `sex_atlas` (reserved names).

## Added obs fields

| field | content |
|---|---|
| cell_type_atlas | label behind cell_type_ontology_term_id: cleaned TME annotation where available, else scanvi_label |
| malignant_selected | cell in the step-19 malignant selection (metaprogram scoring) |
| mp_family / mp_top | assigned metaprogram family (argmax z; 'unassigned' if max z <= 0) / highest-scoring MP; 'not_selected' otherwise |
| mp_max_z / mp_confident / mp_z_<family> | family z-scores; confident = max z >= 1 (cell2location reference subset) |
| tme_compartment / tme_subcluster / tme_marker_label / tme_annotation | cleaned TME clustering (step 22); annotation = curated name (phase6_notes §11) |

## Open before submission

- Run `cellxgene-schema validate data/processed/dmg_atlas_v1.h5ad` (package not in the multiverse env).
- Ensembl IDs come from GRCh38-2020-A (GENCODE v32) symbols; IDs present in v48 are kept as-is, but a symbol may differ from the v48 gene name (the portal re-derives feature_name from the ID).
- '10x (version not stated)' studies (Okada, Collot, Zang) carry the generic EFO:0030080; refine if the chemistry is confirmed.
- Okada age 0.0 (two pons samples) is treated as unrecorded (pediatric stage).
